scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --recursive test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/*.test.ts tools/gates/*.test.ts tools/serve/*.test.ts tests/consumer/*.test.ts && node scripts/check-update-coverage.ts
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @wsagency/wseffect-app test:browser && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.check: pnpm build && node packages/app/dist/codegen/bin.js --check apps/gallery && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm check:repo && pnpm gate:app-capabilities
scripts.perf:noise: pnpm exec node tools/gates/perf.ts --app apps/gallery --self-test --write-noise --reason 'Dedicated perf runner noise-floor measurement'
